newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGC, M.W. Kellogg to build Qatar LNG plant.
newsitem.headline: JGC, M.W. Kellogg to build Qatar LNG plant.

text.p: Japan's JGC Corp said on Monday that it and U.S. firm M.W. Kellogg Co have been awarded a contract to build a gas liquefaction plant as part of Qatar's Ras Laffan liquefied natural gas (LNG) project.
The plant will have the capacity to produce 2.5 million tonnes of LNG a year, a JGC spokesman said.
He declined to say what the contract was worth, but the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun gave an estimate of about $400 million.
It also said the plant was due to be completed in April 2000, which the the JGC spokesman said was roughly right.

Qatar aims to become a leading exporter of LNG. Energy and Industry Minister Abdullah bin Hamad al-Attiyah said in March that Qatar was targetting output of 30 million tonnes based on huge gas reserves at its North Field -- the world's largest non-associated offshore gas field -- and a new industrial city and LNG port at Ras Laffan.
